title: Team search must not request Explain with FIELD_VALUES result format
answers: Why does team search ignore the explain query param?
Search explanations missing from team search API response
How should ResourceSearchRequest.Explain be set for FIELD_VALUES result format
body:
Symptom: callers pass ?explain=true to the team search endpoint but the response never contains search explanations.
Root cause: DoTeamSearch built a resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest with ResultFormat: FIELD_VALUES, but FIELD_VALUES result format does not expose Explain data in the API response, so setting Explain was useless.
Fix pattern: when ResultFormat is FIELD_VALUES, do not set Explain on the ResourceSearchRequest; drop any explain query-param parsing that feeds it.
Constraints: applies to any search handler using resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest with ResultFormat_FIELD_VALUES; if a result format other than FIELD_VALUES is used and the frontend needs explain output, Explain may be reintroduced for that handler.
applies: pkg/registry/apis/iam/team/search.go DoTeamSearch and any future search handler using FIELD_VALUES result format

search: The team search endpoint must not set Explain on ResourceSearchRequest when ResultFormat is FIELD_VALUES, because FIELD_VALUES result format does not expose Explain data in the API response. Any explain query parameter parsing (from ?explain=true) that feeds the Explain field must be dropped for handlers using FIELD_VALUES. This constraint applies to DoTeamSearch in pkg/registry/apis/iam/team/search.go and any future search handler using resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest with ResultFormat_FIELD_VALUES. Other result formats may support Explain and can reintroduce the field if needed for frontend output. Fixes callers who pass ?explain=true but receive no explanation data in response.
